title: All About Ladybirds
note: b416 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new split digraphs o-e, u-e.

pages.brief: A small red ladybird with black spots resting on a broad green leaf.
Close view of the ladybird's red back showing several round black spots.
Close view of the ladybird's underside showing its six small legs.
The ladybird tucked into a tight curled-up position on the leaf.
The ladybird with its red wing cases lifted slightly, pale wings visible beneath.
The ladybird feeding on a tiny greenfly on a plant stem.
The ladybird moving along a healthy green plant stem in the vegetable patch.
Nell the bee noticing the red ladybird resting low in the grass.
Nell the bee hovering close, looking carefully at the ladybird's spots.
Nell the bee smiling as the ladybird climbs slowly up a blade of grass.
